landing_ruling.note: Written by the laptop CTO and named in 1.0.0_SA_CTO~DELL1 msgs 5727 and 5731; NOT on this box's checkout when this record was written.

why_the_landing_is_owed: The function was deployed at 2026-10-14T18:51Z from the build at efb3f6550f, which the naming gate refused on box/dell1. Until this file lands here, box/dell1 and CLOUD hold the older producer, and a package rebuilt from them would regress the deployed function: the four scalars back to the pro-rated figures and no read of registry.json. The landing closes that gap and nothing else.
